playbookOutputs: VAT201 submitted on eFiling from the client's figures
playbookCommonFailures: Client supplies VAT-inclusive totals when VAT-exclusive are expected, or output/input figures swapped
Wrong tax period for the vendor's category (2-monthly A/B vs monthly C)
Client figures do not agree to their own accounting system VAT report and Kevin has not been told the calc is excluded
Return filed but VAT not paid by the last business day of the month → 10% penalty and interest
Zero-rated / exempt supplies entered in the standard-rated field

informationToProvide.label: Company Name, 10-Digit VAT Number & VAT Period (YYYY-MM)
informationToProvide.helpText: Registered company name, 10-digit SARS VAT number (starting with 4), and the VAT period to be filed.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company name, 10-digit SARS VAT number, and VAT201 tax period (YYYY-MM).

informationToProvide.label: Completed VAT Figures for the Period (Standard-Rated Output, Zero-Rated/Exempt, Capital & Other Input VAT)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your finalized output VAT, zero-rated/exempt sales, capital goods input VAT, and other input VAT figures (or state "See attached VAT report").
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client-calculated Output VAT, zero-rated/exempt supplies, and Input VAT figures for the period.

informationToProvide.label: VAT Summary Report from Accounting System for the Period
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the VAT201 summary report exported from Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, or your spreadsheet.
informationToProvide.aiHint: VAT summary report from the client's accounting system supporting the declared VAT201 figures.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access and the client's VAT figures
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Credentials and a complete set of VAT201 field values (or a system VAT report) for the period on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that this service files the figures the client provides and does not calculate them. Ask for the tax period, output VAT on standard-rated supplies, zero-rated and exempt supplies, input VAT on purchases and capital goods, and any adjustments. Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify figures are internally consistent and the period is right
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Field values reconcile (15% check on standard-rated supplies), period matches the vendor category and the return is issued on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Sanity-check: output VAT ≈ 15% of standard-rated supplies (field 1 → field 4); input VAT not more than 15% of purchases; net = output − input. Check period category on eFiling (A/B 2-monthly, C monthly). Flag anything that looks VAT-inclusive. Do not recalculate from source — if the figures are unreliable, raise a proposal to upsell the calculation service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft VAT201 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet lists every VAT201 field number and value with the client's source
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Map to VAT201 fields (1, 1A, 2, 2A, 3, 4, 4A, 5–13 outputs; 14–19 inputs; 20 net). Show payable/refundable and the due date.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Complete and submit the VAT201 on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: VAT201 submitted; confirmation and PRN saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns → VAT201 → select the tax period. Enter each field from the handoff sheet; check the computed VAT payable/refundable matches. Agent drives to the summary; Kevin reviews and presses Submit and captures the PRN. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver submission confirmation and payment details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Filed VAT201, PRN, amount and due date posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Give the amount payable, PRN, and due date (last business day of the month following the period for eFiling vendors ⚠ verify) or say a refund is due and SARS may verify before paying. No deadline threats.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
